title: Sebi to release FII compliance consultation paper within weeks, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
summary: Sebi is likely to release a consultation paper on foreign investor compliance requirements within weeks, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. The proposed document will explore aligning Indian norms with global standards amid heavy FII outflows. The regulator is also planning a capacity-building network to strengthen independent directors’ effectiveness.

title: US bonds rally, sending yields to biggest monthly decline since 2023
summary: US Treasuries experienced a notable rise as technology stock selloffs caused a shift towards safer investments. The yield on the benchmark 10-year note had its largest monthly drop in nearly three years. Earnings reports from Amazon and Intel negatively impacted investor confidence amid rising AI costs. Expectations for a December interest rate hike remain high after a recent Federal Reserve meeting.

title: NTPC Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 5,320 crore; revenue up 17%
summary: NTPC has showcased a strong performance in the second quarter of FY27, with a significant 14% increase in standalone net profit year-on-year. The operational revenue saw a notable rise of 16.8% from the same quarter last year, reflecting solid financial health. An interim dividend of Rs 3 per share was announced for shareholders. In a move to bolster growth, NTPC is also increasing its capital expenditure on pumped storage initiatives.

title: Dalal Street Weak Ahead: Nifty stands on firmer footing, but can it break past 23,450?
summary: The Nifty gained 2% last week, recovering above the crucial 200-week moving average at 22,700. While easing volatility and buying at lower levels support the rebound, bearish momentum indicators suggest caution. Analysts identify 23,300–23,450 as immediate resistance and 22,750–22,525 as key support for the coming week.

title: CDSL Q2 results: Net profit jumps 24% YoY to Rs 173 crore, revenue up 24%
summary: CDSL reported a 24% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 173 crore, while revenue grew 23.7% to Rs 395 crore. EBITDA margin expanded to 58%. The depository opened around 75 lakh new demat accounts during the quarter, taking assets under custody beyond Rs 89 lakh crore.

title: ET Wealth Expo | Only 6 of 1990's Sensex stocks survive: S Naren's case for smarter asset allocation
summary: S Naren of ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund highlights how only six companies from the 1990 Sensex remain in the benchmark today. At ET Wealth Expo, he explained why beaten-down stocks may never recover and urged investors to distinguish between asset allocation and stock selection, while cautioning against chasing strong past returns.

title: Silver loses more than half its value from record high: What went wrong and will it recover?
summary: Silver has plunged more than 58% from its February record high of nearly $120 an ounce to around $50, as profit-booking, weaker industrial demand and shifting macroeconomic conditions weigh on prices. Geojit’s Hareesh V explains what drove the rally, why it unravelled and what could shape silver’s recovery.

title: Turnaround Story: 8 stocks shift from loss to profit in September '26 quarter
summary: Eight Nifty 500 stocks, including IndusInd Bank, Tata Motors and Delhivery, moved from losses to profits in the September 2026 quarter, according to StockEdge's profitability scan.

title: Sebi pushes for resilient capital markets, focuses on investor protection: Chairman
summary: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey emphasized the importance of accessible and efficient capital markets at a recent forum. He highlighted the growth in market capitalisation with significant annual fundraising through equity and debt. The number of investors in West Bengal has dramatically increased, indicating regional market participation. Additionally, various steps have been taken to streamline compliance and fundraising processes for issuers.

title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
summary: Eight BSE 500 stocks gained in each of the five sessions between October 26 and 30, delivering cumulative returns of 10% to 21%.

summary: ICICI Prudential MF's S Naren warns investors against chasing assets after spectacular rallies, highlighting how silver's 216% surge drew record ETF inflows before a 27% correction. title: F&O Talk: Big break above 23,200 can open doors for 23,500 for Nifty; Sudeep Shah picks 6 stocks ahead of Diwali
summary: Nifty could extend its recovery towards 23,500 if it decisively breaks above the 23,150–23,200 resistance zone, says SBI Securities' Sudeep Shah. He also shares his outlook on IT, midcap and smallcap indices, sector trends and six stocks, including TVS Motor, Coforge and ICICI Bank, ahead of Diwali.

title: IPO ahead: Value-fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail gets Sebi nod to raise funds through public issue
summary: Ratnadeep Retail has received Sebi approval to launch an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 400 crore and an offer for sale of 1.49 crore shares. The Hyderabad-based retailer plans to use part of the proceeds to repay borrowings and expand its store network across India.

title: LIC Housing Fin Q2 net profit grows 12% YoY
summary: LIC Housing Finance experienced a 12% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, reaching ₹1,507 crore. Total income for the quarter rose by 1.5% compared to the previous year. A notable improvement in asset quality contributed to the positive financial outcome and led to the reversal of impairment charges. Gross non-performing assets decreased significantly, highlighting better loan performance during the quarter.

title: New India slips into red with 1,267 cr loss in Q2
summary: New India Assurance Company has revealed a concerning net loss of ₹1,267 crore for the September quarter, sharply contrasting with last year's profit of ₹63 crore. The sharp downturn is attributed to underwriting losses in key segments such as property, motor, and health insurance. Despite this, gross written premiums showed a modest increase of 5.14% year-on-year, totaling ₹11,083 crore.

title: Bank of Baroda's Q2 profit surges 36% YoY on NSE stake sale
summary: In a remarkable financial performance, Bank of Baroda reported a staggering 36% rise in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹6,532 crore. This surge was propelled by significant non-interest income, recoveries from previously written-off accounts, and gains from the partial sale of its stake in the National Stock Exchange.

title: Reliance Retail Q2 profit takes a hit on Qcomm push
summary: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a significant drop in net profit, down 24.5% year-on-year to ₹2,619 crore in the last quarter. Despite this, revenue improved by 5.8% to ₹80,220 crore, largely driven by a surge in grocery sales. The company's profitability was affected by strategic investments and evolving festive season patterns, alongside rising finance costs stemming from increased borrowing and interest rates. Focus remains on improving transactions and business model adaptation.

title: Jio Platforms profit zooms 14% on healthy user mix, digital play
summary: Jio Platforms has unveiled an impressive 14% net profit growth to ₹8,387 crore for the September quarter, achieving a milestone subscriber count of 542 million, which includes 300 million utilizing 5G services. Revenue from operations climbed to ₹40,475 crore, fueled by a surge in digital services and a boost in average revenue per user, now at ₹218.8.

title: Airtel Africa Q2 profit rises 16% to $254 million
summary: Airtel Africa has revealed a remarkable 15.9% jump in its quarterly net profit, reaching $254 million, fueled by robust revenue growth. The total revenue escalated to $1.97 billion, showcasing a 25.7% rise in reported currency. Operating profit surged by 28.5% to $659 million, while customer numbers soared by 11.6%, pointing to the growing demand for data and mobile money services. The company achieved a record underlying Ebitda margin of 50.

title: Indian Oil net profit triples YoY to 21,630 cr in Q2
summary: Indian Oil experienced a remarkable surge in its net profit, which soared to ₹21,630 crore for the second quarter. This growth can be attributed to elevated pump prices and government subsidies for LPG sales. In contrast, the same quarter last year showcased a profit of only ₹7,610 crore. Moreover, operational revenue increased by 29%, reaching ₹2,62,935 crore, with the firm's operating profit from petroleum product sales more than doubling.

title: GAIL Q2 profit surges over two fold YoY to 4,650 cr despite global disruptions
summary: GAIL (India) has reported a remarkable increase in net profit, reaching ₹4,650 crore for the September quarter, more than double from the previous year. This growth is attributed to heightened gas marketing margins amid global energy supply disruptions. Revenue also surged by 31% to ₹45,924 crore. Furthermore, GAIL has moved forward with plans to list its subsidiary GAIL Gas, enhancing its stock value by 1.7% to ₹168 per share.

title: ZEE profit sinks 40% YoY in Q2, but revenue rises on FIFA subscription growth
summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises faced a sharp drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, despite a 13% rise in operating revenue to ₹2,225 crore, spurred by FIFA World Cup-related subscriptions. Total costs surged by 18%, largely due to inflated programming and promotional expenses. In a bright spot, ZEE5's revenue surged over twofold, showcasing a successful digital approach.

title: Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
summary: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit takes a hit on exceptional items
summary: Sun Pharmaceutical has seen a notable 36% drop in net profit, juxtaposed with an 11.8% rise in consolidated revenue. The uplift in revenue can be attributed largely to strong sales growth in India and emerging markets, particularly in domestic formulations. Conversely, US formulation sales faced a significant downturn. The company also marked progress in its integration planning for the acquisition of Organon, following the successful completion of regulatory approvals.

title: Varun Beverages Q3 net profit rises 13% YoY, but margins fall
summary: Varun Beverages recorded a substantial net profit increase of 13.5% for the quarter ending September 2026. Although there was strong revenue growth attributed to both local and international sales, the company's shares dropped because of shrinking operating margins. Challenges arose from heightened packaging costs and sugar price surges affecting gross margins. Additionally, Varun Beverages solidified its partnership with PepsiCo, extending their licensing agreement through 2049.

title: Global Markets | European shares stumble at end of best month since June on AI worries
summary: European stock markets slid as a global selloff in technology rattled investors, with the pan-European STOXX 600 index closing in negative territory. Concerns over soaring AI infrastructure costs loomed large. However, to add a silver lining, euro zone growth exceeded forecasts amid climbing inflation and borrowing costs, while firms such as Universal Music Group and Sanofi flaunted impressive earnings in these challenging times.

title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Midterm US elections, earnings, jobs data loom for AI-wary stock market
summary: As we approach the US midterm elections next week, stock investors are bracing for the impact of significant corporate earnings reports. The market is already under pressure due to unsatisfactory AI earnings from leading firms, sparking worries about regulatory challenges. Investor focus will be on earnings from major players like Apple and AMD, with the upcoming jobs report additionally providing insights into the strength of the US economy.

title: Tech rout drives gold to one-year low, white metals sink deep into oversold zone
summary: Gold prices have plummeted to a year-long low, driven by anxiety over AI expenditure trends and declining tech shares. Other precious metals such as silver, platinum, and palladium have similarly seen their values drop sharply. Market experts forecast that precious metals may rebound, particularly if gold stays under $4,000. A decline in demand for silver's industrial and jewelry uses further complicates its market outlook, leaving a persistent downtrend expected.

title: Wall Street drops to its worst day since June after the sell-off for tech stocks deepens
summary: Wall Street’s tech sell-off deepened on Friday as investors questioned whether massive spending on artificial intelligence will deliver enough returns to justify lofty valuations. The S&P 500 fell 1.8% and the Nasdaq 2.9%, with Intel plunging nearly 29% and Nvidia down 4.2%, while bitcoin also slid after a major hack at Binance.

title: Oil-to-chemicals business powers Reliance Industries' record quarterly net profit, up 34% to ₹29,550 crore
summary: Reliance Industries Ltd has set a new benchmark with a record net profit of ₹29,550 crore for the September quarter, fueled by significant advancements in the oil-to-chemicals and digital segments. With a yearly revenue surge of 28.5% to ₹3.38 lakh crore, the O2C division's Ebitda skyrocketed 68%, reflecting the advantages of elevated energy prices and the firm’s adaptability in challenging market scenarios.

title: US stocks today: Dow Jones crashes 500 pts, Nasdaq over 2.5% as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
summary: US stocks tumbled on Friday as disappointing results from Intel and Amazon reignited concerns over rising artificial intelligence spending and uncertain returns. The Nasdaq recorded its biggest single-day percentage decline since June 5. Technology stocks led losses, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also ended October in negative territory.

title: Nasdaq 100 cracks 5%, wipes out $2 trillion in October as AI spending fears deepen
summary: Investor concerns about the high expenditures on artificial intelligence have intensified amidst rising borrowing costs. Major technology companies like Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft are increasing their capital outlays to strengthen AI infrastructure. The Nasdaq 100 index has already seen a significant decline of more than 5.8% in October. Analysts predict that global AI infrastructure spending could reach unprecedented levels by 2030.

title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth

title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
summary: Intel shares plunged 30% after the chipmaker issued a weak fourth-quarter revenue forecast and warned of negative cash flow for the year. The warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks declining as weak PC demand and rising AI infrastructure costs weighed on sentiment.

title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
summary: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.

title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore

Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.

title: Zee Entertainment Q2 profit drops 40% to Rs 46 crore as EBITDA margin contracts to 3.2%

title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
summary: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.

title: Spandana Sphoorty makes profit in Q2 against a loss year-ago

title: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale

title: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: Revenue up 6%, but late festive season, digital spends hit profit
summary: Reliance Retail Q2 Results: The company's gross revenue increased 6.4% YoY to Rs 91,716 crore in Q2FY27, compared with Rs 86,169 crore in the year-ago period. The growth came despite the absence of major festive occasions during the quarter, with the festive calendar shifting to the December quarter.

title: Reliance Industries announces fundraising, to raise Rs 15,000 crore through NCDs
summary: Reliance Industries has approved plans to raise up to Rs 15,000 crore through non-convertible debentures via private placement. The fundraising announcement came with the company's Q2 earnings where it reported a 41% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore.

title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%

summary: Wall Street experienced significant losses as the Nasdaq fell to its lowest level in nearly three months. Major technology stocks like Alphabet and Nvidia also saw notable declines due to investor scrutiny. Defensive sectors like consumer staples and healthcare gained some traction in response to the selloff.
